snippet.title: Slice of Life | Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Coming to the Nintendo Switch eShop in Mid 2020!

What Will We Do Today?
Step into the shoes of Drake Lacasse as he starts a forced new life at Rosegate University. Make new friends, compete on the court, and search for answers in Slice of Life.

Featuring the wonderful Lucahjin as Jill Matthews! 

For more information visit: smallrave.com
